Doña Vicenta associates the opposing side with the killing of her father and the destruction of her world.
Doña Vicenta ultimately agrees to the armored figure's proposal.
The armored figure is forceful, contemptuous of sentiment, and argues for survival through political opportunism.

lore_facts: Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha has inherited the acting presidency of the Troglosocialik Federation.
The Troglosocialik Federation has recently suffered catastrophic violence, including the death of Doña Vicenta's father and the destruction of her people and planet, according to her account.
There is an organized multi-step plan, with this page covering Items 3 and 4.
Bikramen's presence in the Troglosocialik system is important enough to be announced galaxy-wide as part of that plan.
plot_events: A narration box labels this as Item 3 of a plan: a private conversation with Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha, identified as the acting president of the Troglosocialik Federation.
The armored figure urges Doña Vicenta to stop clinging to the past and exploit the new political situation.
Doña Vicenta angrily rejects negotiation with those she says killed her father, her people, and her planet.
The armored figure rebukes her emotional response and argues that survival requires turning defeat into advantage.
Doña Vicenta accepts the plan and asks what to do next.
A narration box labels Item 4 of the plan: publicly announce across the galaxy that Bikramen was present in the Troglosocialik system.

visual_summary: A ruined metallic landscape fills the page, with shattered structures and debris under a smoky sky. In the lower panels, an armored, helmeted figure walks and speaks privately with Doña Vicenta Gabriela de Rokha, who appears distraught and angry. The conversation shifts from her refusal to negotiate with her enemies to her acceptance of the figure's proposed plan.
